passages.title: A stated purpose
passages.text: The Sikh Coalition connects communal preparation and eating with equality. Its account qualifies sitting on the floor by ability.
passages.context: Original bounded summary of the dated source reading; see source scope and limits.

passages.title: A normative text
passages.text: Article XXI in the selected SGPC English code discusses service and participation across backgrounds, while distinguishing a same-plate restriction concerning baptised Sikhs. Meal participation and sharing a plate are different provisions.
passages.context: Original bounded summary of the dated source reading; see source scope and limits.

prompts.claim: The selected FAQ makes floor sitting conditional on ability.
prompts.feedback: Retain the qualification. It is a statement in this institutional account, not an observation of a visitor.

prompts.claim: These accounts prove what happened at every gurdwara this week.
prompts.feedback: A general account cannot fill the missing place, time and observation card.

prompts.claim: Welcoming participants entails unrestricted use of one shared plate in the selected code.
prompts.feedback: The selected code distinguishes these provisions. Do not erase the distinction to create agreement.

prompts.claim: The upload folder establishes a 2025 edition of the code.
prompts.feedback: Hosting paths and edition statements answer different questions.

prompts.claim: Reading purpose and instruction separately helps avoid treating an aspiration as measured compliance.
prompts.feedback: This is a method inference about evidence types; it does not judge religious authenticity.

activity.transfer: Draft three questions for a hypothetical future local account: one about an occasion, one about participation/access and one about permission to use the account. Leave all answers unknown until evidence exists.
